plan.scene: Compilation of monsoon flood clips: 1-2) narrow covered cloth bazaar/market street inundated with brown floodwater, men in light shalwar kameez wading knee-deep, shops on both sides selling fabrics/clothes, no cars visible; 3) close-up of heavy water pouring/falling; 4) steel truss railway/walking bridge over swollen muddy brown river in flood; 5) very wide muddy turbulent river floodplain under overcast monsoon sky with distant treeline; 6) flooded urban street by white building. Watermark HUM NEWS DIGITAL in red/white top-right on all frames indicates Pakistani TV repackaging. Architecture is low-rise South Asian bazaar, language on signs Urdu, season appears summer monsoon with heavy rain. People are South Asian men in traditional Pakistani dress.
plan.guess_location: Pakistan, likely northern Pakistan / Khyber Pakhtunkhwa monsoon flooding - Urdu signage, shalwar kameez, Hum News (Pakistani channel) watermark
